objective: Resolve the independently certified Windows environment findings by expanding proven source values before deriving defaults, rejecting self-referential/unresolved expansions, and restricting minimum-path provenance to local drive-rooted paths while preserving the restricted-stdio managed launch.
closed_decisions: Only already allowlisted, non-secret Windows values may participate in portable expansion.
SystemRoot and TEMP may be expanded from other proven allowlisted values before deriving ComSpec and TMP.
Any remaining variable token, including a self-reference whose substitution is textually unchanged, is rejected rather than treated as resolved.
Safe minimum paths are local drive-rooted absolute paths only; UNC, extended-length, device, relative, traversal, control-character, and unresolved-variable paths are rejected.
Do not change public MCP behavior, custody semantics, dependencies, provider/Tinto sources, or release state.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit files outside the four owned files.
Do not copy unrestricted parent environment values, expose secret values, weaken case-conflict handling, accept unresolved percent variables, or broaden safe paths to UNC/device namespaces.

Do not change custody, process termination, public MCP tools/schemas/dialog behavior, provider/Tinto source, dependencies, manifests, lockfiles, queue/blocker/release files, commits, branches, Jira, or pull requests.

acceptance_criteria.description: A proven source with SystemDrive=C:, SystemRoot=%SystemDrive%\Windows, and TEMP=%SystemRoot%\Temp expands first and reconstructs local ComSpec/TMP with safe-default provenance.
Direct and indirect cycles, including %PATH% stored in PATH, unresolved tokens, and bounded-pass exhaustion are rejected with bounded value-free evidence.
UNC, extended-length, device, relative, traversal, control-character, and variable-bearing minimum paths remain incomplete and never produce ComSpec/TMP defaults.
Focused environment tests, build, and clean real-Tinto stdio READY/first-close-idle probe pass.

focused: pnpm vitest run tests/unit/windows-environment.test.ts tests/unit/launch-environment.test.ts tests/unit/mode-config.test.ts
